description: Make a PDF from JPG and PNG images: one image per page, in the order given. Each image is an https:// URL or a data:image/jpeg;base64,… or data:image/png;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths); the type is detected from the bytes, not the name. At most 100 images, each up to 4 MB, 4.5 MB in total. page_size "fit" (default) makes each page the image's own size at 72 dpi (1 px = 1 pt; pages longer than 5,000 pt on a side are scaled down, tiny images are enlarged to a 3 pt minimum); "a4" or "letter" put the image on a standard page, centred, shrunk to fit inside the margin and never enlarged. orientation (auto, portrait, landscape; default auto picks per image) applies to a4 and letter only. margin is 0-200 pt (default 0 for fit, where the page grows by the margin on every side; 36 for a4 and letter). A JPEG's EXIF orientation is applied, so phone photos come out upright. PNG: 8-bit and 16-bit, palette, grey, interlaced and transparent files work (transparency is kept); animated PNGs, other formats (GIF, WebP, HEIC, TIFF, SVG) and PDFs are rejected. JPEG: baseline and progressive, grey, RGB and Adobe-style CMYK. Very large images fail with image_too_large (PNG over 10 megapixels or a memory estimate; JPEG over 250 megapixels), and many large PNGs in one call with images_too_large_together. Deterministic: the same images give byte-identical output. To join images with existing PDFs use pdf_merge, which also accepts images. Returns the PDF inline as an application/pdf resource.

image_paths.description: In order, one page each: an https:// URL or a data:image/jpeg;base64,… / data:image/png;base64,… URI (this hosted server cannot read local file paths).

margin.description: Points, 0-200. Default 0 for fit, 36 for a4 and letter.

orientation.description: a4 and letter only; auto (default) picks portrait or landscape per image.

page_size.description: fit (default): page = image size. a4 or letter: standard page, image centred and shrunk to fit.

name: pdf_image_to_pdf

bytes.description: Size of the produced PDF in bytes

resource_uri.description: pdfops:// uri of the inline application/pdf resource

title: Make a PDF from JPG and PNG images
